discovery: Read-only public endpoint used by repository SPA bundle at https://openifcmodel.cs.auckland.ac.nz/javascript/build/bundle.js; endpoint observed in getAllModels.
observations: Repository serves a single-page application. Legacy /Model/Details/308 returns the same application shell as the home page.
Model-file names identify WestRiverSide Hospital / Autodesk Hospital and include 20160125 and 20190104 prefixes. A filename prefix is not a verified design/permit date.
The catalog fields do not identify the project address, applicable laws, governing edition or construction approval.

Some descriptions are inconsistent with their associated hospital filenames: structural catalog ID175 describes a Japanese house. Therefore catalog descriptions are not authenticated hospital location evidence.

local_provenance_review.finding: The model card attributes the models to Wawan Solihin (Singapore) and the University of Auckland repository. Donor and host locations are not a project jurisdiction.

identity_limit: The live catalog metadata was not represented as a byte-identity check of the seven retained IFC files. Their hashes and conflicting placeholder coordinates are assessed separately by the source-model review.
